title: Analysing Hyperactivity and Attention Deficit Behaviour in the Child

text_simplified: The text describes the story of a child struggling with difficulties in concentration and attention, displaying impulsive behaviours such as talking non-stop and finding it hard to sit still. Parents are advised to provide a calm and supportive environment for the child, along with using short motivational methods to enhance focus.

review_defects.english: The text describes the story of a child
review_defects.why: Arabic uses indefinite 'قصة' (a story), but English uses definite 'the story', implying a specific known story rather than an example.
